source.notes: Rigid FR-4, 4 or more layers (the Multilayer rows), 1 oz copper. Each rule names the row it comes from; rules marked as the author's choice are defaults, not limits. Re-read the page before ordering: JLCPCB changes it.

drill_files.source: The capabilities page (read 2026-11-11) gives hole tolerances (Drilling, "Hole size Tolerance": "Through-holes: +0.13 / -0.08 mm") and finished sizes ("e.g. for the 0.6mm hole size, the finished hole size between 0.52mm to 0.73mm is acceptable.") but does not say whether drill files list finished or drilled sizes.

clearance_fill_board_edge.source: Outline, "Routed": "0.2mm"; "① Copper clearance from routed board edges: ≧0.2 mm".

clearance_fill_fill.source: Traces, "Min. track width and spacing (1 oz)": "0.10 / 0.10 mm (4 / 4 mil)"; "Multilayer: 0.09 / 0.09 mm (3.5 / 3.5 mil). 3 mil is acceptable in BGA fan-outs.".

clearance_fill_npth_hole.source: Traces, "NPTH to Track": "0.2mm". JLCPCB gives no inner-layer NPTH row.

clearance_fill_pth_hole.source: Traces, "PTH to Track": "0.28mm", "0.35mm is recommended, minimum 0.28mm"; Traces, "Inner layer PTH pad hole to copper clearance": "0.3mm". One rule covers every layer: the recommended value, chosen over the minimum (0.28 mm), which is also above the inner-layer value.

clearance_fill_via_hole.source: Traces, "Via hole to Track": "0.2mm"; Traces, "Inner layer via hole to copper clearance": "0.2mm".

clearance_npth_hole_npth_hole.source: Drilling, "Pad Hole-to-Hole Spacing": "0.45mm". JLCPCB gives no NPTH-specific row; Sparksmith reads the pad hole row as covering unplated pad holes too (founder decision, 2026-11-12).
